rule_or_requirement: Qualified finishes and shorter off-road excursions require a controllable recovery action.
observable_information: TRAIN-only simulator track and car pose for teacher, plus pixel-road visibility; runtime candidate is not yet implemented.
allowed_action_or_state_change: At fewer than three visible road-center rows, substitute teacher heading-error steer toward a 12-meter centerline lookahead; inherit gas/brake.
expected_success_endpoint: All six control finishes retained, >=20 action changes, zero invalid actions and >=10-decision low-visibility reduction on at least two of three slow-loss cells.
control: Exact frozen visual mode-switch ZIP SHA b0dc7a24e6ef994cee6e663ec6605f5aa088dbb9b3ce4510f90ccd16dc9d7fc4 on six consumed TRAIN cells.
falsifier: Lost qualified finish, invalid action, insufficient action change or fewer than two shortened low-visibility intervals.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two arms on six consumed TRAIN cells, twelve episodes; teacher-only diagnostic.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU teacher diagnostic capped at 1,200 seconds and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
